About me

I turned five separate tools into one simple system — then added AI to take over the repetitive work.

It’s called Devoted OS: the all-in-one web app a home care agency in California runs on every day. It helps schedule caregivers, spots concerns in care notes and answers staff questions.

  • A person has the final sayThe AI suggests; staff approve before anything is saved or sent.
  • Client privacy comes firstNames are removed before the AI sees anything, and each person only sees what their role allows.
  • Built to be reliableOver 2,700 automated checks, every update confirmed on the live site, and every feature reviewed personally by the company’s owner.

Selected Projects

Things I've built

Devoted OS · AI automations in daily useDevoted Care Services · 2026

Devoted OS is the all-in-one web app I built for Devoted Care Services, a home care agency in California, covering scheduling, client care, finance, sales leads, HR and marketing. These diagrams show the AI automations inside it; select one to see it full size.

Featured · live since Nov 2026

AI Availability Agent

Texts each caregiver a short availability form when their schedule review is due, then uses AI (Claude) to turn their replies, call notes and form answers into a suggested schedule. A scheduler approves it before anything is saved.

100+ caregiversruns every 15 minnothing saved without approval
ClaudeQuo SMSMicrosoft GraphHuman-in-the-loopCron

Website Lead Intake → CRM

When someone fills in the form on a partner’s website, they show up as a new lead in the agency’s CRM within seconds, with spam and bot protection. Website search statistics also flow into live charts.

lead in the CRM in secondsspam protectionTeams alert
REST APIWebhooksSupabaseMicrosoft Teams

AxisCare Sync + AI Care-Note Review

Copies caregivers, clients and visits from AxisCare (the agency’s care software) every 10 minutes. Every 30 minutes, AI reads care notes with names removed, compares them with what’s normal for each client, and turns anything worrying into a task for staff.

updated every 10 minAI review every 30 minno names sent to AI
Scheduled jobsClaudePrivacy by designSupabase

AI Assistant for Staff

Staff ask questions in plain words and the AI (Claude) finds the answer in scheduling, client, finance and task records. Each person only gets answers from the areas they’re allowed to see.

4 areas of the businesspermissions checked on every question
Claude tool useAccess controlNext.js

Social Media Monitor + Weekly Report

Pulls Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube results into one dashboard every hour, builds the weekly PowerPoint report in one click, and translates non-English comments with AI.
